run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config and specified stages
load_config_validate: load and validate a FastCSP workflow configuration from a YAML file for requested stages
detect_restart_workflow: detect if the FastCSP workflow is a restart by checking for an existing log file
run_genarris_generation: run Genarris jobs to generate putative crystal structures for a given molecule file
filter_deduplicate_structures: filter and deduplicate ML-relaxed structures using energy and density cutoffs
